'''Caloria''' was an astronomical object located in the [[Reena Province]] of the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]].<ref name="LE" /> It lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Caloria Run/Legends|Caloria Run]], which connected it to the [[Canti system/Legends|Canti]] and [[Tanger system/Legends|Tanger systems]].<ref name="PGT" />
